BiblicalUsage: Pithchon is an opening, the opening of the mouth. God promises Ezekiel the opening of the mouth in the midst of Israel in Ezekiel 29:21, and tells Jerusalem she will never open her mouth again because of her shame in Ezekiel 16:63.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God opens mouths to speak His word, and shame shuts them.
